data.title: Shareholder ID & Address Verification
data.description: Required identification documents for individual stakeholders holding shares.

requestedDocuments.description: High-quality color scan of the valid passport biodata page.
Copy of the national identity card (front and back).
Recent utility bill (DEWA/Etisalat) or bank statement issued in the last 3 months.
Standard declaration form regarding the origin of invested funds.

data.title: Enhanced Shareholder Due Diligence
data.description: Extended document set for shareholders above 25% threshold or flagged as high-risk.

requestedDocuments.description: High-quality color scan of the valid passport biodata page.
Driving license, national ID or any other government-issued photo ID.
Two separate documents confirming residential address — utility bill and bank statement, both issued within 3 months.
Standard declaration form regarding the origin of invested funds.
Self-declaration confirming PEP status and that the individual is not subject to sanctions.
Last 6 months of personal bank statements to evidence source of funds.
Certificate confirming tax residency jurisdiction for FATCA/CRS compliance.

data.title: Corporate Shareholder Verification
data.description: Documents required when the shareholder is a corporate entity rather than a natural person.

requestedDocuments.description: Official incorporation certificate of the shareholding company.
Latest constitutional documents of the shareholding entity.
Current registers for both directors and shareholders of the corporate shareholder — may be supplied as separate documents.
Completed template declaring all Ultimate Beneficial Owners with ≥25% stake.
Passport copy and proof of residence for each identified UBO of the corporate shareholder.
Last 2 years of audited financial statements of the corporate shareholder entity.
